title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the senior reviewer.

pr_url.title: PR URL
pr_url.description: Which single pull request is this session about?

junior.title: Junior
junior.description: Who authored the PR, as role:handle?

senior.title: Senior
senior.description: Who is reviewing and owns this record, as role:handle?

session_date.title: Session date
session_date.description: On which date did the session take place, as YYYY-MM-DD?

evaluation_use.title: Evaluation use
evaluation_use.description: Will this record be used in performance evaluation, and how? Stated now so the junior is not surprised later.

learning_goal.title: Learning goal
learning_goal.description: Which one skill, stated as what the junior's code will do differently (e.g. writes a migration that is safe to re-run)? No attitude words.

gap_did.title: Gap: what the code did
gap_did.description: What did the code do at the anchored line?

gap_should.title: Gap: what the code should do
gap_should.description: What should the code have done instead?

gap_line_url.title: Gap line URL
gap_line_url.description: Which diff-line or review-comment anchor (#discussion_r..., #L..., #note_...) shows the gap?

restated_gap.title: Restated gap
restated_gap.description: How did the junior restate the gap in their own words before writing the fix?

issue_count.title: Issue count
issue_count.description: How many comments were labelled issue?

nitpick_count.title: Nitpick count
nitpick_count.description: How many comments were labelled nitpick? If more than all other labels combined, the goal was not addressed.

praise_count.title: Praise count
praise_count.description: How many comments were labelled praise, each pointing at a specific line the junior got right? At least one.

prior_record_url.title: Prior record URL
prior_record_url.description: Where is the previous session record for this junior? Write null if this is the first session.

not_demonstrated_streak.title: Not-demonstrated streak
not_demonstrated_streak.description: How many consecutive sessions has the same goal been judged not-demonstrated? At 3 the intervention changes and the manager is told.

follow_up_action.title: Follow-up action
follow_up_action.description: What behaviour will the junior demonstrate in the next PR? Not 'keep this in mind'.

follow_up_window.title: Follow-up window
follow_up_window.description: By when must the follow-up PR land — N days (at most 14) or next-two-prs?
